text:
lucy: midweek derby update: i somehow scored the ultimate flex by predicting the 2-1 upset and now the office pool is on. whos bringing breakfast for the winner? :croissant:
omar: you predicted that??? teach me your ways. also i declare a loser breakfast: loser brings bagels and terrible coffee next monday. :bagel:
chris: wait rules: tie on points -> rematch penalty shootout at lunch. not kidding. :soccer:
tam: can we at least have neutral judge? chris will rig penalties by doing intimidating eyebrow.
chris: nope my eyebrow is a secret weapon. :smirk:
lucy: also side bet: most dramatic celebration wins a $10 card. stakes are high.
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Loser breakfast preference" 1) Bagels + coffee 2) Donuts + soda 3) Full brunch. Vote with :one:, :two:, or :three:. Poll ends in 2h.
omar: full brunch seems excessive but i'm in if we can schedule.
tl: whoops typo, tam meant "tl". tam: i will not pay for brunch if someone misses the penalty rematch.
chris: speaking of penalties, reminder to sign waiver for field use. link: https://pickup.fields/waiver (do it or you sit out).
lucy: scoreboard for pool so far: lucy 7, omar 5, tam 5, chris 3. i'm running out of smugness to deliver. :trophy:
omar: curious: any streaming of the match? want to dunk the clip in #random-highlights if it's spicy.
chris: i'll clip the winning goal if it happens. footage quality: will be "iphone 2017".
tam: need one more volunteer to keep the scoreboard next week. do not make me do it.
lucy: @tam i'll do it if you bring the coffee when we inevitably lose. deal?
tam: deal. but if we win, i'm claiming the $10 celebration card too.
poll-bot: Update: Poll tally 1h in: 6 votes. Results leaning to Bagels + coffee. Poll ends at 1955555521.
chris: bagels it is. adding a stipulation: cinnamon bagels only if winner sings the anthem.
omar: pls no singing. my ears are still traumatized from karaoke night. :grimacing:
lucy: ok post-match plans: celebrate, eat, and maybe embargo the penalty video until monday doomscroll. winner posts clip with caption "office derby hero."
chris: sounds good. may the best toe win. :soccer_ball:
